answer_1.quote: Make-A-Voice ... for 4 applications: text-to-speech (TTS), voice conversion (VC), singing voice synthesis (SVS), and singing voice conversion (SVC).
datasets: Multilingual dataset (English, Chinese, French, German, Spanish, Japanese)

answer_2.quote: Intelligibility and accuracy. We employ word error rate (WER) to evaluate the intelligibility of the generated speech ... Style quality and similarity. Speaker similarity score (SIM) assesses the coherence ... F0 Frame Error (FFE) measures the timbre and prosody similarity ... We transcribe the translated speech for accuracy and then calculate the BLEU score ...

answer_4.quote: We also conduct a crowd-sourced human evaluation via Amazon Mechanical Turk ...
answer_4.guideline: For audio quality, raters were instructed to 'focus on examining the audio quality and naturalness, and ignore the differences of style (timbre, emotion, and prosody).' For style similarity, raters were instructed to 'focus on the similarity of the style (timbre, emotion, and prosody) between the generated and reference audio, and ignore the audio quality.'
